How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 02-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your completed application via email is 02-09-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc. in Physics, Astronomy, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field with at least 60% marks and a valid NET/GATE score. Alternatively, a B.E./B.Tech. in a relevant field with 75% marks and a valid NET/GATE score is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 35 years. Age relaxations will be provided as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000/- per month for the third, fourth, and fifth years, plus HRA as per norms.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT BHU?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with all required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Indian Institute of Technology Banaras Hindu University.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section on this page. It is highly recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.
